# Rivers, mountain ridges and historical frontier lines (hand-drawn, approximate).
# Provinces grow from their towns but avoid crossing these lines, so borders
# snap onto real geography.
#   ~ Name     river (drawn on the map, crossing it matters in battle)
#   ^ Name     mountain ridge
#   = Name     frontier line (invisible; shapes borders only)
# followed by "lat lon" points along the line.
